title: Importing Databases Into Local Dev Environments (XAMPP, MAMP, Local)
description: Get a big production database running on your laptop without fighting bundled PHP limits.
bullets: Each stack ships its own PHP and php.ini — edit the right one
The bundled mysql CLI beats phpMyAdmin for large dumps
Match charset to utf8mb4 to avoid garbled characters
Split the dump when you can't or won't touch config files
